materiality.rationale: vToken decouples logical token liveness from physical KV blocks through indirection and asynchronous repacking while preserving PagedAttention and CUDA Graph compatibility in vLLM; it matters as a concrete approach to reclaimable serving memory without discarding existing execution paths.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate is relevant because KV-cache fragmentation and reclamation directly constrain long-context serving; vToken connects a systems change to compatibility with the serving primitives operators already use.
